title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Batch
description: API Gateway REST API endpoint to AWS Batch

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template creates an API Gateway REST API integration with AWS Batch and can submit jobs to AWS Batch. This pattern addresses some nuances with defining the VTL template mapping when integrating with AWS Batch. It also creates an IAM execution role with permissions to submit AWS Batch job.
